title: Add adjustable 'time taken' field to AddDoseDialog
name: AddDoseDialog
description: New givenAtEpochMillis state defaults to the current time at dialog-open (System.currentTimeMillis(), captured once via remember) and is adjustable through the new shared TimeTakenField (same package, no import needed), placed between the medication chips and the dose-amount field. onSubmit's type grows a givenAtEpochMillis: Long parameter. Everything else (profile/medication selection, dose amount, notify toggle) is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: New state: var givenAtEpochMillis by remember { mutableStateOf(System.currentTimeMillis()) }
A TimeTakenField(initialEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis, onEpochMillisChange = { givenAtEpochMillis = it }, ...) is added after the medication chips Row and before the dose-amount OutlinedTextField

onSubmit's type becomes (profileId: Int, medicationId: Int, doseAmount: String, givenAtEpochMillis: Long, notifyOnNextDose: Boolean) -> Unit, and the confirm button passes givenAtEpochMillis in that position
Who/Medication chips, dose amount field, and notify-on-next-dose switch are unchanged
